Chapter 1138: Chapter 7: Xuanhuang Universe (Subscription Requested)_2

This resurrection power does not require any reliance; as long as one has existed before, they can be resurrected.

“Advance to the thirteenth realm?”

Nine Phoenix Great Saint fell silent; she paused the fight with Shadow Demon Great Saint due to this consideration.

The universe opened by this supreme Great Saint likely stores insights on advancing to the thirteenth realm.

If she can acquire them, her future hope of advancing to the thirteenth realm might increase.

As for why the supreme Great Saint has not returned? It is basically impossible for them to advance to the thirteenth realm? Yet, every Great Saint who has perfected the Chaos Realm is full of confidence, walking their own paths.

Even if this supreme Great Saint failed to reach the thirteenth realm, it does not mean she will fail too.

“Alright.”

Nine Phoenix Great Saint weighed the pros and cons and finally made a decision.

All grudges are insignificant when facing the challenge of the thirteenth realm.

Upon hearing this, Shadow Demon Great Saint sighed in relief.

He was worried that Nine Phoenix Great Saint might continue to go berserk and ignore this universe.

“Now let’s join forces to smash this section of the universe, then proceed inside.”

Shadow Demon Great Saint said, for what they were seeing was only part of this universe; the entire universe remained intact.

To enter, they either need the method to access it or forcefully smash their way in.

“Yes.”

Nine Phoenix Great Saint nodded.

…

Rumble.

The full-force combined strike of the two Great Saints was much stronger than Nine Phoenix’s earlier attack.

The terrifying chaotic power tore through space-time and hurled towards the revealed section of the universe.

Buzzing.

In an instant.

The universe suddenly emitted infinite Xuanhuang Qi, rapidly diluting the combined strike of Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Great Saint under its protection.

Meanwhile.

A heavy wave of space-time fluctuations spread in all directions, the strike from the two Great Saints reverberating like hitting an ancient bell, the terrifying sound waves expanding through the boundless space-time.

“Not good.”

Shadow Demon Great Saint and Nine Phoenix Great Saint’s expressions changed.

Their combined strike not only failed to smash this section of the universe but even failed to shake it.

A postnatal universe left from eons ago holds terrifying depths, even when its internal space-time neared collapse, it easily blocked the strike of these two Great Saints.

What was the strength of the supreme Great Saint who originally opened this universe?

Yet Shadow Demon Great Saint and Nine Phoenix Great Saint could not think deeply about these matters, for the result of their combined strike was the emergence of terrifying space-time ripple waves.

These space-time ripple waves spread toward the surrounding Void Domains.

“What’s going on?”

“These space-time fluctuations?”

Within each Void Domain, Chaos Venerables faintly sensed and looked towards the source of the space-time fluctuations.

“This fluctuation? Is it the fluctuation of a universe? A postnatal universe? The universe opened by a supreme Great Saint?”

“Inside a postnatal universe opened by a supreme Great Saint, surely lies many treasures and profound insights, possibly even realizations for advancing to the thirteenth realm.”

“Great opportunity, this is a great opportunity.”

…

The eyes of each Chaos Venerable burned with passion, advancement to the thirteenth realm is not merely the goal of Chaos Great Saints; even those new to Chaos Realm have this yearning.

This exists within the postnatal universe opened by the supreme Great Saint.

Even if the realizations for advancing to the thirteenth realm are not obtained, the treasures and divine artifacts left by a supreme Great Saint are sufficient for Chaos Venerables to benefit endlessly.

“Let’s go.”

“Go over there now.”

Immediately, some Chaos Venerables could not hold back and moved toward the source of the space-time fluctuations.

Indeed, this space-time fluctuation from the postnatal universe also contains waves of Great Saint-level power.

This means that besides that universe, there should be Chaos Great Saints.

Yet, does it matter?

Normally, Chaos Venerables do not wish to offend a Great Saint.

However, faced with an irresistible opportunity, what does a Chaos Great Saint matter?

…

“A postnatal universe created by a peerless Great Sage…”

The heavy fluctuations of time and space continued to spread, also alarming some Chaos Great Saints.

In the Chaos Void, each Void Domain would have a few Chaos Venerables, but as for a Chaos Great Saint? Even dozens or hundreds of Void Domains might not have one.

“Is it the aura of the Shadow Demon and the Nine Phoenix? Those two are quite lucky, stumbling upon an undiscovered postnatal universe?”

A Chaos Great Saint, eyes deep and penetrating, immediately deduced the cause and effect of the situation.

The grudge between the Nine Phoenix Great Saint and the Shadow Demon Great Saint is not a secret among the Chaos Great Saints.

The battles between the two Great Saints were just a spectacle for the other Great Saints, who weren’t bothered to intervene as long as it didn’t affect them.

…

In the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, in the ‘Fragment World’ of Star Tear.

Lin Yuan’s expression was solemn as he looked at the beast skin floating before him.

This piece of beast skin was something Lin Yuan obtained from a golden box inscribed with the mark of the Profound Xuanhuang.

According to the description by the six-armed silhouette in the Spirit of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, the golden box likely passed through the hands of His Majesty Xuanhuang.

The treasure inside is a precious artifact of the Profound Xuanhuang lineage.

“Is it a map?”

Lin Yuan discovered the root of the beast skin’s anomaly was the map on its surface.

“Has the location marked on the map emerged?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, pondering that the map on the beast skin depicted a tomb, and according to the Spirit of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, this tomb belonged to His Majesty Xuanhuang.

However, the map included areas within the mausoleum, but Lin Yuan did not know the coordinates of its location.

Only when the mausoleum emerged, revealing its aura to resonate with the map, could it be known.

Originally, Lin Yuan held little hope for the map, after all, who knew when His Majesty Xuanhuang’s tomb would emerge?

Even after millions of Cosmic Eras passed without any sign, he assumed it would remain the same for millions more.

But now?

The anomaly on the map of the beast skin led Lin Yuan to speculate that His Majesty Xuanhuang’s tomb might have truly emerged.

“Specific space-time coordinates…”

Lin Yuan split a trace of his Primordial Spirit, exploring the map on the beast skin, vaguely resonating with the mausoleum the map corresponded to.

“Is it there?”

Lin Yuan gazed in a certain direction, his eyebrows furrowing, “Too far.”

Even with only a rough correspondence, Lin Yuan could sense the vast distance between the mausoleum and his current position?

Even with Lin Yuan’s current understanding of time and space, traveling with full effort and continuously void-traveling, it would still take hundreds or even thousands of years to reach it.

“Hmm?”

At this moment, Lin Yuan felt a slight stirring in his heart.

“The Galaxy.”

Ancient Ming Chaos Venerable sent a message.

Lin Yuan looked opposite, where the form of the Ancient Ming Chaos Venerable coagulated.

Of course, what coagulated was merely the incarnation of the Ancient Ming Chaos Venerable, and it could only descend and coagulate with Lin Yuan’s consent.

“A major event has occurred.”

The Ancient Ming Chaos Venerable’s expression was solemn as he swiftly conveyed the information he had just received: “Between the Ripple Cloud Void Domain and Anbo Void Domain, a postnatal universe has appeared in the Desolate Void.”

How important is a postnatal universe? It is enough to drive the Great Saints to madness; once this news spreads, it will only spread rapidly with terrifying speed.

As a seasoned Chaos Realm entity, the Ancient Ming Venerable knew many Venerables and naturally received this news.

“A postnatal universe?”

Lin Yuan’s expression remained unchanged, though waves stirred within his heart.

The location mentioned by the Ancient Ming Venerable was precisely the space-time coordinates Lin Yuan sensed through the map on the beast skin.

Coupled with the sudden appearance of a postnatal universe… Lin Yuan could almost confirm that this postnatal universe was related to His Majesty Xuanhuang, possibly even created by him.

The mausoleum represented by the map on the beast skin is likely within this postnatal universe.

“Now many Venerables are rushing there, including some at the pinnacle of the Chaos Realm, and possibly even Great Saints. If it weren’t for the postnatal universe being so far away, I would have gone to take a look myself.”

The Ancient Ming Chaos Venerable said with a shake of his head.

“It is indeed very far,” Lin Yuan nodded.

The Desolate Void between the Ripple Cloud Void Domain and Anbo Void Domain would require him to travel through the void continuously for hundreds of years to reach.

The Ancient Ming Venerable estimated it would be thousands or tens of thousands of years before he could arrive.

“Forget it, it’s too far. Even if I rush there, the contention would probably be long over by the time I arrive.”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment, considering it quietly to himself.

With his foundation, a postnatal universe is not something he absolutely must have.
